key_insight: SpaCellAgent is a self-evolving LLM multi-agent system that turns natural-language requests into fully automated trajectory inference and spatiotemporal analysis workflows.
engineering_relevance: It reduces manual intervention and tool expertise requirements, making advanced single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analysis more accessible and scalable for computational biology teams.
method: Multi-agent planner decomposes the analysis task into workflow steps.
Dynamic tool-orchestration engine selects and adapts algorithms during execution.
Self-evolution module uses feedback to iteratively refine performance and outputs.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on six heterogeneous datasets spanning diverse developmental trajectories, sequencing platforms, and spatial tissue architectures, and reportedly improved analytical efficiency by over 40% while staying aligned with expert performance.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of tool integration, feedback signals, and dataset-specific tuning, so robust validation is needed when deploying on new biological contexts.
paper_title: SpaCellAgent: A Self-Evolving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Trajectory Analysis
